comment: M3 Starforge 视听清单 — 可重放：execute_workflow(workflow_id, {prompt}) 后同名落位。风格尾缀锁定见 docs/m3-art-plan-starforge.md。

bgm.note: audioConvert 的 wav 配置未生效，产物为 mp3；本地 ffmpeg -ar 22050 转 WAV 落位

assets.prompt: a single molten mineral sphere game asset, glowing crack veins across the surface, grayscale monochrome, perfectly centered, round silhouette, pure black background, orthographic view, high detail, no text, no watermark
a black hole game asset, pure black sphere with a thin glowing white-violet accretion ring, centered, round silhouette, pure black background, orthographic view, high detail, no text, no watermark
assets.note: 黑体被去背移除，仅环可用——按设计叠加在暗色核心上

a game upgrade icon, glowing molten planet core, simple bold readable shapes, warm orange glow, centered, pure black background, flat game icon style, no text, no watermark

sparse ambient deep-space menu music, 96 bpm, D minor, soft warm synth pads, distant metallic forge resonance, slow evolving, hopeful and vast, seamless loop, no vocals

intense deep-space gameplay music variation, 96 bpm, D minor, same theme denser and more urgent, faster arpeggios, heavier sub-bass, rising tension near a black hole, metallic forge percussion, seamless loop, no vocals
